rule: Unrestricted repeatable powers; no one-off temporary boosts

characters.name: Iron Man
characters.powers: Powered armor flight, repulsors, sensors, targeting AI, nanotechnology
characters.wins_and_feats: Defeated Iron Monger; fought Thanos on Titan with team; helped defeat Thanos by using Stones at lethal cost
characters.losses_and_limits: Lost to Steve Rogers and Bucky in Civil War; Thanos overwhelmed him on Titan; suit-dependent
characters.score_rationale: Armor and AI provide repeatable flight, targeting, strength, and precision; strategy and invention unusually strong; impulsivity limits composure
characters.confidence: provisional; primary-scene descriptions and official profile links; source-by-source verification outstanding

characters.name: Captain America
characters.powers: Super-soldier strength, reflexes, endurance, shield mastery; Mjolnir only conditional
characters.wins_and_feats: Defeated Red Skull's forces; fought Winter Soldier; with Bucky defeated Iron Man; briefly fought Thanos with Mjolnir
characters.losses_and_limits: Overpowered by Thanos; not immune to weapons or heavy hitters
characters.score_rationale: Exceptional leadership and composure; accurate shield throwing; physical capabilities superhuman but far below cosmic characters
characters.confidence: provisional; primary-scene descriptions and official profile links; source-by-source verification outstanding

characters.name: Thor
characters.powers: Asgardian physiology, lightning, flight and weapon control with Mjolnir/Stormbreaker
characters.wins_and_feats: Defeated Hela's troops; struck Thanos with Stormbreaker; helped defeat Thanos in Endgame
characters.losses_and_limits: Hela destroyed Mjolnir; Thanos defeated him at start of Infinity War; Gorr challenged him
characters.score_rationale: Stormbreaker is standard late-era weapon; lightning enables extreme reach and vertical movement; accuracy and decision-making not automatically perfect
characters.confidence: provisional; primary-scene descriptions and official profile links; source-by-source verification outstanding

characters.name: Hulk

characters.losses_and_limits: Thanos defeated Hulk in Infinity War; Hulkbuster restrained him; uncontrolled rage
characters.score_rationale: Massive strength/leap and durability; limited finesse and tactics in rage form; keep separate from Smart Hulk
